{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows sustained positive sentiment (e.g., >0.5) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% when true outcomes show persistent overshoots after recent spikes.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if model forecast is >10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 10-15%.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment shifts: if sentiment turns negative (e.g., <0.0), reduce forecast by 5-10%.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is >10% above model forecast on day 1-3, adjust forecast downward by 5-10% for next period.",
    "Avoid overreacting to single-day spikes: if model forecast spikes >15% above prior 5-day average, apply a 10% dampening factor.",
    "For long-term (30d) forecasts, apply a 5-10% downward bias if sentiment history shows no strong bullish signals."
  ]
}
